Draft graph.json for this:

Explain our CI pipeline: a developer pushes a branch to GitHub, GitHub Actions runs the lint, the tests and a build in parallel, and when all pass it publishes a Docker image to the registry and deploys it to staging.

$schema.description: The JSON Schema for this file, for editors. Ignored by explAIn-it.

id.description: Stable id, used by edges, zones and the storyboard.

kind.description: Sets the default size, height and colour.

zone.description: The id of the zone the node sits in.

category.description: A palette category name; a node's defaults by its kind, an edge's and a zone's to the accent.
A palette category name; a node's defaults by its kind, an edge's and a zone's to the accent.

graph.description: The structure of a flow. Mermaid is generated from it.

assumptions.description: What you assumed where the description left it open, each in a sentence.

questions.description: At most 2 questions whose answers would change the draft; none when nothing would.

reply.text: {"graph":{"version":1,"title":"CI pipeline: push to staging","nodes":[{"id":"dev","label":"Developer","kind":"actor","icon":"user"},{"id":"github","label":"GitHub","kind":"external","icon":"git-branch"},{"id":"actions","label":"GitHub Actions","kind":"service","icon":"workflow","zone":"ci"},{"id":"lint","label":"Lint","kind":"service","icon":"search-check","zone":"ci"},{"id":"tests","label":"Tests","kind":"service","icon":"flask-conical","zone":"ci"},{"id":"build","label":"Build","kind":"service","icon":"hammer","zone":"ci"},{"id":"gate","label":"All passed?","kind":"decision","zone":"ci"},{"id":"registry","label":"Image registry","kind":"external","icon":"package"},{"id":"staging","label":"Staging","kind":"service","icon":"server"}],"edges":[{"id":"push","from":"dev","to":"github","label":"push branch"},{"id":"trigger","from":"github","to":"actions","label":"webhook"},{"id":"run_lint","from":"actions","to":"lint","label":"run"},{"id":"run_tests","from":"actions","to":"tests","label":"run"},{"id":"run_build","from":"actions","to":"build","label":"run"},{"id":"lint_done","from":"lint","to":"gate","label":"result"},{"id":"tests_done","from":"tests","to":"gate","label":"result"},{"id":"build_done","from":"build","to":"gate","label":"result"},{"id":"publish","from":"gate","to":"registry","label":"all pass: push image"},{"id":"deploy","from":"registry","to":"staging","label":"deploy image"}],"zones":[{"id":"ci","label":"CI pipeline"}]},"assumptions":["GitHub Actions is the runner that starts and coordinates the lint, test and build jobs, so it sits inside the CI zone.","The decision node stands for the check that all three jobs passed before publishing.","The Docker image goes to a separate registry, and staging pulls it from there.","Node icons follow the default kinds, with a specific Lucide icon chosen for lint, tests, build and the registry."],"questions":[]}
